_note: Health and day-intensity tuning (GDD 4.5–4.6). M2 step 1 only uses the intensity settings; body areas, strain rates, thresholds, illness rates and the rival injury chance come with the health model (step 3).

intensity._note: Per-day intensity (this week's day changes). load = multiplier on the fatigue a session adds; effect = multiplier on its training stimulus. Normal must stay 1.0 / 1.0 so the weekly plan behaves as before. Races ignore intensity.

easy.name: Easy
easy.description: Run the sessions gently: less tiring, a bit less training effect.

hard.name: Hard
hard.description: Push harder than planned: a bit more training effect, but much more tiring.
